description: Wording for the two copy-message buttons in index.html: the per-member '复制付款消息' (payment message) and the '📢 复制到货通知' (group arrival announcement, at the top of the page). Edit THIS file to change how either message reads — do not edit index.html for wording changes. {placeholders} are filled in automatically from real data (product name, quantity, unit, amount, adjustment note, actual weight, total, member names, pickup location) — keep them in the text, just move/reword what's around them. Re-upload this file to the repo root to apply changes; no index.html edit or redeploy of the app itself needed. Payment-message style matches how WG团购群 already writes these by hand: "@name", no emoji, amounts prefixed with "$" (e.g. "$16", "-$6.5"), blank line before the item list and before the total, "一共$X～". IMPORTANT: the field names below (itemLine, weightSuffix, adjNoteSuffix, adjItemLine, adjOtherLine, etc.) are exactly what index.html's buildMemberMessage()/buildGroupAnnouncement() look for — renaming a field or its {placeholder} silently breaks that piece of the message with no error shown anywhere, since fillTemplate() quietly fills an unrecognized placeholder with an empty string rather than failing loudly. If you want to redesign how weight/notes are combined (e.g. one unified parenthetical instead of two separate ones), that needs an index.html code change to match, not just a rename here.
